_about: Limits the guard (crew/guard.py) enforces on every OpenCode job while it runs. No AI reads this: software counts and stops the job. For each limit the TIGHTEST of defaults, the job type and the member wins. tokens = fresh input + output + cached input re-read (every step re-sends the conversation, so cached input is most of the bill). Kris edits these; nothing else needs to change.
